report.explanation: All observed checkout requests returned 200 with 63-94ms durations; traces show every downstream hop (inventory, payment, order, redis, postgres) completing successfully with pool size/idle=1 and no errors. Metrics show zero 502s and p95 checkout ~98ms. No evidence establishes a fault; the alert may reflect normal latency. No bounded root cause is supported, so hand off for a latency baseline and longer-window confirmation.
missing_evidence: Baseline latency SLO/threshold for /v1/checkout to determine whether 63-94ms is anomalous
Sustained latency/error metrics over a longer window to confirm or exclude downstream-latency
Per-dependency latency breakdown (payment, inventory, redis, postgres) to localize any slow hop
